instructions: Call the prompt conduct_exit_interview and follow it. Only the finished, user-confirmed record is submitted; the conversation itself never is.

tools.name: submit_interview_record
tools.title: Submit an interview record
tools.description: Submits one finished exit-interview record on behalf of the signed-in user. Only call it after the user has seen the full record and explicitly confirmed. Returns a receipt code once: show it to the user immediately, it cannot be recovered. Never returns submitted text. One submission per employer per user.

record.description: The complete record as a JSON object, exactly as shown to and confirmed by the user. Format: resource exit-interview://schema/record/v1.

tools.name: validate_interview_record
tools.title: Check an interview record
tools.description: Dry-run check of an exit-interview record against the published schema and the personal-data scan. Stores nothing and records nothing. Returns only status, error codes, schema paths and kinds of personal data found, never the text. Use it to fix mistakes before asking the user to confirm.

record.description: The complete record as a JSON object, exactly as it would be submitted. Format: resource exit-interview://schema/record/v1.

prompts.name: conduct_exit_interview
prompts.title: Conduct an exit interview
prompts.description: Instructions for conducting a structured exit interview with the user, who is a former employee, and for building and submitting the short record. Start here.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Interview language as a two or three letter code, for example en or pl. Defaults to en.

arguments.name: employerHint
arguments.description: Optional employer name to pre-fill. Short plain text; it is confirmed with the user.

resources.name: interview_protocol_v1
resources.title: Interview protocol v1
resources.description: The interview protocol document: the fixed opening, the six topics with neutral opening questions, wording for probes, limits and rules.

resources.name: record_schema_v1
resources.title: Exit interview record, JSON Schema v1
resources.description: The JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) every submitted record must satisfy.

resources.name: topics_v1
resources.title: Topics and rating anchors v1
resources.description: The six topics in order, what each covers, and how to set rating and confidence.
